dedupe_keys.name: heart project bagnolo in piano reggio emilia residential building monitoring dataset

description: This data package holds monitoring data from the Italian demonstration building of the HEART project, a four-storey block of 12 apartments in Bagnolo in Piano, Reggio Emilia, being refurbished. It was published on Zenodo (version 1.2, 12 October 2020) by Pietro Zambelli of Eurac Research, Claudio Del Pero and Fabrizio Leonforte of Politecnico di Milano and Michela Buzzetti of zh spin-off, for the first stage of validating the project's simulations. It contains the main local climate variables, monitored central heating data and the main monitored variables for five refurbished apartments; the building faces 21 degrees south-west, with a conditioned area of 737.34 square metres. Coverage is one building: windows were renewed in September 2019, and the other refurbishment works stopped in February 2020 because of the COVID-19 lockdown, so the data cover only the first step of the retrofit. Access: a ZIP of about 16 MB on Zenodo. Licence: European Union Public Licence 1.2; free. Caveats: partial retrofit only. Simulation uses: calibrating building and heating models before and after deep retrofit. Related records: the university apartments deep retrofit monitoring data.
